warnings.message: the storage drive is exfat: it ignores case in names and is slower than ext4

notes: Where the files are (set in config.json on the server) and how full the drive is. storage is "disk" or "s3"; with a bucket, s3_bucket and s3_endpoint name it, and storage_dir, fs_type, total_bytes and free_bytes are empty or 0. files and bytes count the library; the trash is counted apart. fs_type, total_bytes and free_bytes are empty or 0 if the drive can't be asked. warnings is what `share check` finds, problems first; [] when all is well. Their codes and levels are in contract/storage_warnings.json; message is the console's English text.
